Recommendations: High pollution locations show stronger potential for energy recovery from waste and emissions.
Locations with high CO2 emissions should focus on carbon capture, waste-to-energy systems, and cleaner transportation.
Industrial waste can be converted into useful energy through biomass, biogas, incineration, and recycling-based recovery systems.
Energy recovery improves when pollution sources are systematically collected, treated, and converted using clean technologies.
Policy focus should be given to locations with high Total Pollution Index and low energy recovery output.
